podcast.body: Featured on the album "Payable on Death," the music video for this song conveyed a message of reciprocity: "do unto others as you would have them do unto you." "P.O.D. with Will You from their 2003 album, Payable on Death."

podcast.body: Taken from their 2003 album, "Payable on Death." The song's video conveyed a strong message of reciprocity and kindness, reflecting a "do-unto-others-as-you-would-have-them-do-unto-you" ethos. "P.O.D. with Will You from their 2003 album, Payable on Death."
